Category: local-only universal developer-data decoder and evidence inspector
Brand thesis: Reveal Ledger — 불투명한 값을 과장 없이 후보·단계·근거로 정리하는 로컬 판독 장부
Signature moment: 합성 또는 사용자 입력 뒤 orange edge로 연결된 Decode chain이 단계 번호·형식·입력 크기·confidence를 드러내고 Inspector가 선택된 값을 나란히 보여 주는 순간
Media production route: R2
Route decision: lowercase d의 counter와 slash 교차를 16px에서도 통제해야 하고 OG까지 같은 geometry로 파생하므로 수제 SVG 원본이 맞다.
User job carried by this route: 작은 탭부터 공유 카드까지 같은 d/slash 판독 신호와 Reveal Ledger 정체성을 알아본다.
Rejected routes: R3: AI raster는 작은 크기 실루엣, 정확한 글자 geometry와 반복 가능한 파생을 보장하지 못한다.; R6: 실사 사진은 developer decoder의 기호 정체성과 입력·근거 관계를 전달하지 못한다.
Color-system mode and simultaneous accent budget: restrained_brand; 2
Color roles: neutral=#F3F1EA at --paper; brand_primary=#101827 at --ink; brand_secondary=#FF6440 at --accent-2; semantic_state=#087B66 at --mint; semantic_state=#B4233B at --danger
Multi-hue and hard-shadow cluster boundary: functional_only; not_used; apps/web/src/styles/global.css와 2026-09-04 production 320/390/1440 캡처에서 decorative multi-hue cluster 없이 두 accent만 동시에 사용한다.
Component primitive boundary: bespoke_accessible/retain_existing; behavior=Preact and native DOM own focus-visible, keyboard tree navigation, button disabled/loading/error/success state, details disclosure, ARIA roles, and reduced-motion behavior.; brand=apps/web/src/styles/global.css owns Reveal Ledger palette, type, grid, density, radius, shadow, responsive ordering and state surfaces; route components do not import a generic visual kit.; channels=web:dom:bespoke_accessible:required, desktop:webview_dom:bespoke_accessible:required
Typography and inclusive UI contract: docs/design/inclusive-ui.json
Page structure: sticky compact ledger header → compressed outcome hero → horizontal synthetic-case rail → full-width local workbench → trust footer
Hero and section rhythm: 좌측 정렬 mono category label, 두 색의 2행 H1, 한 문단 mechanism, 0-byte-upload proof를 두고 별도 hero CTA 없이 실제 입력면으로 이어진다.; warm-paper grid의 짧은 hero 다음, 얕은 합성 사례 rail과 짙은 paste surface가 하나의 Reveal Ledger 프레임을 만들고 결과 시 chain/inspector가 아래로 확장된다.
Structural repetition boundary: distinct; 겹치는 축은 설명 비용을 낮추는 공통 문법이다. decod.ing의 자유 입력, 증거 점수, 재귀 tree, inspector로 이어지는 단일 워크벤치 구조와 dark decode surface는 sampled products에 없다.

Stale patterns to avoid: 해커 느낌의 neon green terminal chrome과 의미 없는 code rain; gradient orb·glass card·AI sparkle로 기능 부족을 덮는 범용 생성형 SaaS hero
Distinctive product cues: lowercase d를 가르는 orange signal slash와 decod.ing의 orange dot; warm-paper ledger grid 위 blue-black paste surface와 orange decode edge; 단계 번호·input bytes·confidence·evidence가 같은 baseline에서 이어지는 chain anatomy
Subject: lowercase d divided by an orange decode signal slash
Composition: centered cream d with preserved counter and a bottom-left to top-right slash inside a 16-unit rounded blue-black square
Style and medium: hand-authored flat SVG with three semantic fills/strokes and no filter
Color palette: #0C1423; #F7F4EA; #FF6440
Text policy: No text, letters, wordmark, product name, slogan, watermark, or UI labels inside the asset.
Constraints: remain legible at 16px; preserve the d counter and round-cap slash; no script, external reference, filter, or embedded raster
Avoid: text inside an empty rectangle as the main visual; generic purple-blue gradient without product meaning; competitor trade dress or identifiable artist imitation; decorative Three.js particles, floating orbs, code rain, or AI sparkle; secure, verified, or valid wording for decode success without matching evidence; generic code brackets; AI sparkle; thin slash that disappears at favicon size; an empty framed rectangle with the product name as the main visual; text-only card used as a substitute for an illustration or symbol; generic purple-blue gradient, glassmorphism, or clay icons without product meaning; competitor trade dress, protected artwork, watermarks, and identifiable artist imitation; hallucinated letters, illegible labels, accidental logos, and generation artifacts
Fallback requirement: visible decod.ing HTML wordmark in apps/web/src/layouts/Layout.astro
Reference boundary: learn from the recorded category conventions only; do not copy any comparable screen or brand style.
